service.en: Replacement for a lost death certificate
service.ur: گم شدہ وفات سرٹیفکیٹ کا متبادل

about: Get a replacement copy of a lost death certificate.
note: Requirements read from the official EHS service page on the checked date. EHS fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Replacement for a lost death certificate. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Relatives of the deceased up to the fourth degree, legal representatives or embassy representatives
documents: No documents listed; the notification (QAID) number and birth date are entered in the application
